merged_yaml:
---
".nested-base":
  tags: []
  variables:
    NESTED: '1'
build:
  tags: []
  variables:
    NESTED: '1'
  stage: build
  extends: ".nested-base"
  script:
  - echo build
".common-base":
  interruptible: true
  variables:
    FROM_COMMON: 'yes'
".login":
  script:
  - echo "login step"
".python-base":
  interruptible: true
  variables:
    FROM_COMMON: 'yes'
  extends: ".common-base"
  image: "$PYTHON_IMAGE"
  before_script:
  - echo "python-base setup"
".disc-uv":
  image: "$PYTHON_IMAGE"
  stage: test
  interruptible: true
  variables:
    UV_CACHE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.uv-cache"
    UV_LINK_MODE: copy
    UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS: never
    PACKAGE: ''
  cache:
    key: uv-disc
    paths:
    - ".uv-cache"
  before_script:
  - cd "."
  - if [ -n "$PACKAGE" ]; then uv sync --locked --package "$PACKAGE"; else uv sync
    --locked; fi
  after_script:
  - uv cache prune --ci
disc-lint:
  image: "$PYTHON_IMAGE"
  stage: test
  interruptible: true
  variables:
    UV_CACHE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.uv-cache"
    UV_LINK_MODE: copy
    UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS: never
    PACKAGE: ''
    RUFF: true
  cache:
    key: uv-disc
    paths:
    - ".uv-cache"
  before_script:
  - cd "."
  - if [ -n "$PACKAGE" ]; then uv sync --locked --package "$PACKAGE"; else uv sync
    --locked; fi
  after_script:
  - uv cache prune --ci
  extends: ".disc-uv"
  rules:
  - if: $RUFF == "true"
  script:
  - uv run --no-sync ruff check .
  - uv run --no-sync ruff format --check .
disc-test:
  image: "$PYTHON_IMAGE"
  stage: test
  interruptible: true
  variables:
    UV_CACHE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.uv-cache"
    UV_LINK_MODE: copy
    UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS: never
    PACKAGE: ''
  cache:
    key: uv-disc
    paths:
    - ".uv-cache"
  before_script:
  - cd "."
  - if [ -n "$PACKAGE" ]; then uv sync --locked --package "$PACKAGE"; else uv sync
    --locked; fi
  after_script:
  - uv cache prune --ci
  extends: ".disc-uv"
  script:
  - uv run --no-sync pytest --junitxml="$CI_PROJECT_DIR/report-disc.xml"
  artifacts:
    when: always
    reports:
      junit:
      - report-disc.xml
deploy:
  stage: deploy
  script:
  - echo deploy
stages:
- ".pre"
- test
- build
- deploy
- downstream
- ".post"
unit:
  interruptible: true
  variables:
    FROM_COMMON: 'yes'
  extends: ".python-base"
  image: "$PYTHON_IMAGE"
  before_script:
  - echo "python-base setup"
  stage: test
  script:
  - - echo "login step"
  - echo "unit tests"
child:
  stage: downstream
  trigger:
    include: ci/child.yml
    strategy: mirror
generate:
  stage: build
  script:
  - printf 'generated-job:\n  script:\n    - echo generated\n' > generated.yml
  artifacts:
    paths:
    - generated.yml
dynamic-child:
  stage: downstream
  needs:
  - generate
  trigger:
    include:
    - artifact: generated.yml
      job: generate
    strategy: mirror
charts-pipeline:
  stage: downstream
  trigger:
    project: platform/charts
    branch: main
